Thanks again for the time earlier, Jordan — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side.

Recap:
- Use cases: customer support chat (primary), knowledge retrieval + embeddings for semantic search, occasional reranking for high-value queries.
- Desired pilot scope: 1 month, production-ish traffic to validate latency/cost.
- Tech constraints: PKI + SSO, SOC 2 compliance (you flagged audit questions), and ability to pin model versions.

Pricing/volume questions we discussed (please confirm):
- Approx token volume (chat): ~150M tokens/month
- Embeddings: ~2M embed requests/month (small input size)
- Rerank: ~8M tokens/month (spikey)
- Target blended unit economics: target ~$50 per 1M tokens (you mentioned wanting a number in that ballpark)

Model mix (please confirm per-model % if different):
- Chat (conversational/vectored context): 80% of token volume
- Embeddings (semantic search vectors): 15% of requests (counted separately from tokens)
- Rerank (short re-ranks over candidates): 5% of token volume

Attachments: redwood_pricing_card.pdf — quick reference for list/unit rates and our recommended pilot configuration.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm the monthly volumes and per-model mix above (or correct).
2) We’ll send a one-page commercial summary + draft MAA/PO path.
3) Kick off 2-week pilot once MAA/PO is greenlit (we’ll allocate a dedicated pool and a contact for onboarding).

If you can confirm numbers by EOD Thursday (PST) we’ll try to get the commercial back to you by Friday.

Thanks — Marissa

Jordan — thanks for the numbers, perfect. Below is a concise commercial summary and recommended configuration for the pilot so you can share with Priya/procurement. I attached a draft MAA (ACME_MAA_draft.pdf) as requested.

Recommended blended pricing (pilot):
- Assumptions: 150M chat tokens, 2M embedding calls, 8M rerank tokens. Blended calc uses token-equivalent for embeddings (we’ll invoice embeddings as embedding-units; see line items).

Per-unit list guidance:
- Chat (high-quality chat model): $45 / 1M tokens
- Embeddings (standard vec model): $12 / 1M embedding-requests
- Rerank (efficient rerank model): $30 / 1M tokens

Blended estimate (monthly):
- Chat: 150M tokens -> 150 * $45 = $6,750
- Embeddings: 2M calls -> 2 * $12 = $24 (we bill embeddings per million requests)
- Rerank: 8M tokens -> 8 * $30 = $240
- Total estimated monthly: $7,014 -> Rounded estimate $7,000 - $7,200
- Effective blended rate: ~$46.76 per 1M tokens (chat+rerk included; embeddings billed separately but impact negligible).

Notes & options to hit a lower budget: 
- Lower-cost model variants: we can run a quantized chat model (Q4-like) at ~$30 / 1M tokens; switching chat to that variant would bring blended to ~ $33 / 1M -> ~ $4,950/mo for your stated volumes.
- Batching & prefix caching: we’ll enable automatic caching for common prefixes which can reduce token usage by ~5-12% depending on session reuse.
- Commitment discounts: Reserved monthly commits (3–12 months) can reduce effective unit rates by another 10–25% depending on term.

SLA & pilot details: 
- For Dedicated pilot we offer target p95 latency SLAs for chat of <250ms for 512-token contexts (when using dedicated pool); we’ll include exact SLA language in the MAA appendix.
- We’ll provide onboarding support and a single technical point-of-contact (Dylan) for integration.

Next steps (I’ll do these once you confirm):
1) Marissa sends one-page commercial + final MAA & PO instructions (attached).
2) You confirm pilot kickoff date and which chat model variant you want (HQ or quantized cost-saving).
3) We schedule a short onboarding call with Dylan and Rachel to set up telemetry + cost/usage dashboards.

If Priya or procurement want any specific terms in the MAA we can iterate quickly — we’ve had fast turnaround on similar pilot agreements.

Cheers,
Marissa
